sections.title: C. Choosing a starting load without equipment

items: **Repetitions in reserve (RIR)**: "How many more reps could you have done?" Aim for 1 to 3 for strength. **RPE (0 to 10)**: aim for about 6 to 8 for strength.
**Rep test**: find the weight the patient can lift 10 times with good form and some difficulty.

rows: All sets completed easily, RIR above 3, symptoms stable
Symptoms flare beyond the agreed rule (for example over 24 hours)
Reduce load or volume; maintain frequency
Change variable (tempo, range, exercise selection, frequency)

sections.title: E. Adherence: making patients actually do it

items: Few exercises (2 to 4) linked to the patient's own goals.
Use habits: attach exercises to daily routines.

blocks.label: COMMON STUDENT TRAP
body: A 15-exercise home program printed on three pages is rarely done. A short, meaningful program done consistently beats a perfect program never started.

sections.title: F. Graded activity and graded exposure

blocks.text: For persistent pain, increase activity by time or quota, not by pain. Graded exposure gradually confronts feared movements (for example bending) in a structured hierarchy to reduce fear.

items: **What does RIR 2 mean?** The patient could have done 2 more repetitions.
**When do you progress load?** When sets are completed easily with good form and stable symptoms.
**How many exercises in a typical home program?** Usually 2 to 4, focused on goals.
**What is graded activity?** Increasing activity by pre-set quotas rather than by pain.
**What is moderate aerobic intensity on RPE 6 to 20?** About 12 to 13.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Set and progress loads using RIR and RPE.

sections.A: Bunyadi usool: specificity (jo karoge wahi behtar hoga), progressive overload (load dheere dheere barhana) aur reversibility.
sections.B: FITT har exercise ke liye: aerobic hafte mein 3-5 din, strength har muscle group ke liye 2-3 din, waghaira.
sections.C: Bina machine ke load: RIR (kitne aur reps kar sakte the). Aam taur par 1-3 reps baqi hon.
sections.D: Sab sets aasaan, RIR 3 se zyada aur symptoms stable: load barhayein. Symptoms barhein: kam karein.
sections.E: Kam exercises (2-4) jo patient ke goals se judi hon, saaf likhi ya video hidayat, aur progress track karna.
sections.F: Lambe dard mein activity waqt ya quota se barhayein, dard se nahi. Graded exposure darr wali activities par kaam karta hai.
sections.G: Sawaal hal karein. RIR 2 ka matlab hai patient 2 aur reps kar sakta tha.
